items.t: Occidental Petroleum Generates Strong FCF - Is OXY Stock Too Cheap?
items.sum: Occidental Petroleum reported very strong Q3 operating cash flow and free cash flow. But even if revenue drops next year, assuming oil and gas prices fall, OXY could still be undervalued.
